_note: TEMPLATE for declarative site rules. Copy to `siteRules.json` (same folder) and add YOUR site rows there — `siteRules.json` is gitignored and hot-reloaded (no restart needed). A rule applies when ANY string in `match` is contained in the URL, and is checked AFTER the hand-written providers but BEFORE the generic fallback. Fields: match (required string[]), name, impersonate (chrome|safari|edge|null), format (yt-dlp -f), extractorArgs (string[] -> --extractor-args), hlsNative (bool -> --hls-prefer-native --hls-use-mpegts), socketTimeout (number), referer ('self' or a URL), headers (object -> --add-header K:V). Entries without a non-empty `match` array are ignored (so this _note is skipped).
